instructions_to_main_agent: Use 'Manrope' for all headings and 'DM Sans' for body text. Add the Google Fonts link to index.html immediately.
Ensure the Primary Green (#1B5E20) is used for active states and primary buttons.
Do NOT use pure black. Use #1A1C1A or slate-900.
The 'Solutions' section should use a grid layout with cards that have a subtle hover lift.
The 'Blog' should look like a clean editorial (medium.com style) with large typography.
Admin panel must be clean, use a sidebar navigation, and focus on content editing.
Use the provided 'Richat Structure' image as a strategic visual metaphor - do not overuse generic stock photos.
Implement a 'Glassmorphic' sticky header: bg-white/80 backdrop-blur-md border-b border-slate-100.

principles: No 'AI Slop': Avoid generic centered layouts. Use asymmetry.
Whitespace: Use py-24 or py-32 for section spacing.
Interaction: All buttons must have hover/active states.
donots: Do NOT use gradients for text.
Do NOT use 'Inter' font for headings.
Do NOT use 100% full width images without containers unless it is a background.
Do NOT make the logo spin.
